body: Actual mouse selection succeeded in both readers but epub.js selected events did not fire in WebKit script-disabled srcdoc frames (WebKit 218086). A shared parent-side observer reads only the focused reader selection and emits after stable selection, preserving embedded-script isolation and native-event deduplication. Both desktop WebKit cases were seen failing before the fix; the full candidate image passes both readers on desktop and mobile WebKit profiles with annotation payload, browser identity, rendered result and malicious-script canary assertions. Mobile profile uses focused DOM selection, not physical OS handles. Candidate fix for #2208; public release pending.

resolution.note: Implemented and independently verified on the full #2208 candidate image; not yet released.

title: Safari cannot open highlight creation controls in sandboxed EPUB readers
